title.en: CONSTITUTION TRANSFER OF FUNCTIONS AND CONSEQUENTIAL PROVISIONS ORDER 1993

source.name: Attorney General's Chambers, Brunei Darussalam (AGC) — LAWS OF BRUNEI / Government Gazette

text.en: In this Order unless the context otherwise requires -Interpretation. 'Functions' includes any powers, duties, privileges or benefits conferred or imposed by any written law on any person or authority.

The functions conferred or imposed on the person or authority spec,i-Transfer of fied in the first column of the Schedule by the provisions of law specified functions. opposite thereto in the second column of that Schedule are hereby transferred to the person or authority specified opposite thereto in the third column of that Schedule.
